about_the_game:
You, Ripley, have been worked to the bone in an effort to stay on the straight and narrow. Cooking, plating, rinsing, repeating. On your one day off, you decide to take your partner Iris and their camera to a planning party for your friend Erik’s future thesis film. But the footage Erik wants to capture is more than you or Iris bargained for.

Will you be able to protect your partner from what lies before you?

This Party is Killer DEMO is the introduction to the full horror visual novel inspired by classic American slasher films. Playing as Ripley, you make choices throughout the night of the party to ensure the comfort and sanity of your partner. You can also search your surroundings "point-and-click" style for key insights into the world you are exploring.

  • An atmospheric visual novel with choices throughout; get a taste of the decisions to be made in the full version

  • Choose how you take care of Iris; decide your combined fates

  • Watch the wheel of cyclical violence spin in a short but sweet format

  • Over 80+ lovingly painted pieces of key art

  • LGBT+ cast of characters

  • Uncomfortable encounters that will leave you squirming

content_descriptors.notes: TPIK contains scenes violence, killing, and unwanted advances. There is also mentions of harming a fictional character who is a minor. Player discretion is still advised.
